blockers.description: deploy.yml's `caddy reload` step is structurally broken: appleboy/scp-action replaces Caddyfile via rename/untar, which changes its inode; Docker's bind mount (captured at container start) keeps pointing at the orphaned old inode, so `caddy reload` inside the container reloads stale content. This has silently affected every Caddyfile-only deploy since the reload step was added (quick task 260903-dvp) — it went undetected because the deploy that introduced it also recreated the container for an unrelated reason (new image tag), masking the bug. Caused a real ~2min public 502 on nonprod after 13-05's Caddyfile push (deploy-to-netcup reported green throughout). Manually fixed by force-recreating the caddy container on netcup-prod directly (`docker compose up -d --force-recreate caddy`) — confirmed via matching md5sum between host file and container-visible file, and nonprod's public health endpoint returning 200. NOT yet fixed in deploy.yml itself — will recur on every future Caddyfile-only deploy, including 13-06's production cutover, unless fixed before then.
blockers.workaround: Manual `--force-recreate caddy` on the VM after any Caddyfile-only push, until deploy.yml is fixed properly.
